text:
incidents-bot: INCIDENT created: inference-pool-usw - node flapping / NotReady spike. paging oncall-miguel :rotating_light:

oncall-miguel: ack, I'm on it. pulling logs and checking routing now.

jane-sre: seeing a cluster-level surge in NotReady for nodes labeled pool=inference-usw, ~3 nodes in last 2m.

sasha-runtime: paste: logs from runtime pod on node-03:
```
OOMKilled: signal 9 - GPUAllocator failed: CUDA out of memory
container restart count: 3
2026-02-14T16:15:02Z runtime[pid]: kvcache restore failed: partial state
```

priya-eng: routing update: switching smart-routing policy to prefer eu-west and dedicated-fallback for high-latency customers. applying quick policy: `api->route: prefer_region: eu-west, fallback: dedicated-small`

oncall-miguel: steps I ran: `kubectl get nodes -l pool=inference-usw -o wide` shows node-03/07/11 NotReady. `kubectl describe node node-03` shows kubelet restart and image GC thrash.

alice-support: customer impact: we have spike in 503s for realtime endpoints, ~5% error rate. AcmeCorp and BetaChat reported errors. Support pinged both.

sasha-runtime: temp mitigations in progress: 1) cordon node-03 & node-07 (`kubectl cordon node-03`) 2) drain with `--ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` for safe eviction 3) bump replica targets on healthy pools in eu-west to absorb traffic.

jane-sre: infra-bot run health-check: `infra-bot check inferpool-usw`

infra-bot: check started: inferpool-usw: 2 nodes NotReady, 1 degraded. autoscaler has queued pods pending due to unschedulable taints. ETA to free capacity if nothing else: ~3m.

priya-eng: also enabling model-variant-fallback for high-priority customers to quantized-v2 (lower mem) via console toggle. should reduce GPU mem pressure.

oncall-miguel: I'm doing live drain on node-03 now, will monitor fallback success and error rate. tagging @alice-support to keep customers updated.

alice-support: updating incident note to customers: "We're seeing intermittent capacity errors in US-West inference pool. We're routing traffic to backup regions and applying mitigations. No data loss. ETA for stabilizing 10-20m."

sasha-runtime: FYI logs show repeated `kubelet: kernel oom-killer invoked` + `nvidia-driver reset` on node-07 - looks like GPU driver instability + container memory pressure. planning node reboot after drain.

jane-sre: merging a quick node selector change for non-latency-critical jobs to shift off gpu nodes: `kubectl patch deployment noncritical -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"nodeSelector":{"pool":"cpu-batch"}}}}}'`

oncall-miguel: error rate dropped to ~1.2% after routing switch + drains. taking over for the next 30m, handing off to sasha-runtime at 16:40 UTC for pager rotation. if things re-flare, escalate to infra oncall.

incidents-bot: INCIDENT update: inference-pool-usw -> status: mitigation in progress. next update scheduled in 10m.

sasha-runtime: ack taking handoff at 16:40. follow-ups: check driver versions on failing nodes, collect dmesg + nvidia-smi logs, open support ticket with cloud provider if driver resets persist.

oncall-miguel: thanks team. adding postmortem checklist: capture pod logs, node dmesg, kubelet logs, autoscaler events, and routing config changes.

alice-support: will send an updated customer note once sasha confirms stabilization. :thumbsup:

incidents-bot: INCIDENT resolved? not yet. monitoring continues.
